우리 — the rig

STEP 1 + 2 · ANATOMY, FITTED TO THE REFERENCE SILHOUETTE

No cut-out image any more. 우리 is assembled from real anatomical parts — two shoulder domes, an upper arm hanging from each, an elbow, a forearm, a wrist, a fist; the chamber with its two cores; the pelvis; two propulsion pylons; the command moon. Each part is a shape with its own surface and its own pivot, chained shoulder → elbow → wrist. The parts were fitted automatically to your reference silhouette, then each part's outer edge was conformed to the reference outline, so at rest the parts together are the silhouette. Colours here only show which part is which; materials come in step 4.
